groups.saying_opens: لا تكونن إن استطعت أول من يدخل السوق
أن جبريل عليه السلام أتى نبي الله

notes: Two sayings: Salman's warning on the market (saying 1) and the Jibril report (saying 2), each stored with its own isnad.
«قال وأنبئت أن جبريل» : «أنبئت» is a passive with no named transmitter, so it is an unnamed link (rule 8).
In saying 2 Umm Salama speaks inside the story; she is not added as a link because the text names Usama as the source of Abu Uthman. The point is uncertain.
«- قال ابن حماد حدثنا معتمر بن سليمان -» is the same man as «المعتمر» and is written once, in its fuller form (rule 7).
